project_type: 4A Store v2 monorepo: Node/Express/TypeScript/Prisma API (api-node) + React 18/Vite SPA storefront & admin (web). Local grocery store. Live API on AWS EC2 at /var/www/html/api-node (pm2 app '4astore-api'), nginx, domain https://4astore.com.
build_system: api-node: tsc (prisma generate for the typed client). web: Vite — build is 'tsc -b && vite build'. No monorepo task runner; each package is built from its own dir.
test_framework: No unit-test framework is configured in either package.json. Verification is done via tsc --noEmit, prisma validate, vite build, and curl against a locally-run dev server (npm run dev).
build_command: api-node: `npx tsc --noEmit` (type check) and `npx prisma generate`. web: `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build).
test_command: No automated test runner. Use: api-node `npx tsc --noEmit` + `npx prisma validate` + curl checks against `npm run dev`; web `npx tsc --noEmit` + `npm run build`.
verification_instructions: api-node (cd 4astore-v2/api-node): 1) `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; 2) `npx prisma validate` clean; 3) seo.sql re-runnable (manual on MariaDB 10.4 — ADD-only, 2nd run prints 'already exists'); 4) start `npm run dev` then: curl /api/sitemap.xml → valid XML; curl /api/robots.txt → valid; curl -A 'Googlebot' /api/og/product/1 → HTML with title/description/keywords/canonical/OG + Product & LocalBusiness JSON-LD; curl /api/products → includes seo_* + og_image (null when unset); curl /api/config → config.seo default object present. web (cd 4astore-v2/web): `npx tsc --noEmit` + `npm run build` clean; admin SEO sub-tab saves+reads global/per-product/per-page; ProductDetails Helmet emits SEO title/description/canonical + JSON-LD; previews render. Confirm OG routes/features/config are REUSED not broken/duplicated (no second canvas pipeline; og.ts extended not forked; all API JSON ADD-only).
snapshot_or_generated_files: `npx prisma generate` regenerates the Prisma client from schema.prisma (not checked in as source, but must be run after editing schema.prisma for the typed client to expose new product columns). Vite `npm run build` emits web/dist (the deploy artifact). No committed snapshots.
environment_constraints: Do NOT git commit or push. New SQL is applied MANUALLY by the user on the live MariaDB 10.4 DB — never auto-run migrations; never use Prisma migrate for pages/config/settings (they are NOT Prisma models). MariaDB 10.4 lacks reliable ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS → every new column MUST use the information_schema guard pattern. Keep OG share image <=100KB (reuse existing compressor). Local Node API port in curl examples is 4000 (per OG-SETUP.md); use actual config.port locally.
contribution_requirements: Backward-compatible API: ADD keys only, never remove/rename existing JSON keys. Guarded idempotent SQL in a NEW prisma/*.sql file (never an unguarded ALTER). Reuse existing symbols: getOrRenderOg/renderOgImage + RenderOgOptions (services/og.ts); shareHtml/escapeHtml/absoluteImageUrl/SITE_ORIGIN/API_ORIGIN (routes/og.ts); mergeFeatures/FEATURE_KEYS (utils/features.ts) + isFeatureOn/FEATURE_LABELS (web lib/features.ts); the config-JSON parse helper `(v)=> typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v??null` and `UPDATE config SET <col> = ? WHERE id = 1` write pattern; react-helmet-async <Helmet>; AdminSettings SUBS sub-tab pattern + lib/admin.ts savers + qc.invalidateQueries(['config']). Admin writes go under requireAuth+requireStaff('settings'). Bilingual Hindi/English admin copy. Only already-installed deps (@napi-rs/canvas 0.1.65 api; react-helmet-async ^2.0.5 + dompurify 2.5.9 web).
key_patterns: Guarded SQL: see prisma/charges-settings.sql — SET @c := (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='<t>' AND COLUMN_NAME='<c>'); SET @sql := IF(@c=0,'ALTER TABLE <t> ADD COLUMN ...','SELECT ''<c> already exists'' AS note'); PREPARE stmt FROM @sql; EXECUTE stmt; DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;. Config read: catalog.ts GET /config uses cached('config',...) + parse() + mergeFeatures; add config.seo there. Config write: admin.ts POST handlers under requireStaff('settings') do UPDATE config SET <col> = ? WHERE id = 1 with JSON.stringify, Zod-validated. pages/config/settings are raw tables ($queryRawUnsafe/$executeRawUnsafe), NOT Prisma models; products/categories ARE Prisma models (prisma.product.*). OG routes mounted app.use('/api/og', ogRouter) in server.ts; catalog mounted app.use('/api', catalogRouter). shareHtml() in routes/og.ts already emits og/twitter meta + canonical + redirect — EXTEND its ShareMeta interface for keywords/robots/JSON-LD rather than writing new HTML. AdminSettings sub-tab: add to SUBS const, add a Settings component mirroring FeaturesSettings(), add render guard {sub==='seo' && <SeoSettings/>}, add saver to lib/admin.ts.
relevant_files: 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/admin.ts (productSchema, pageSchema, settings/config writers under requireStaff('settings') — add per-product SEO, page keywords, POST /seo)
4astore-v2/api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts (NEW — local defaults, SeoConfig, deriveProductSeo, JSON-LD builders)
4astore-v2/api-node/SEO-SETUP.md (NEW — realistic-expectation doc + SUMMARY + EC2 deploy steps)

directory_structure: 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/* (express routers: catalog, admin, og, pages, users, orders, push, ...), src/services/* (og.ts canvas generator, push, schedulers), src/utils/* (features.ts, http.ts), src/seo/* (NEW). prisma/*.sql are manually-applied guarded migrations; schema.prisma mirrors the DB. 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/* (storefront pages + admin/ subdir), src/lib/* (api.ts axios instance, queries.ts react-query hooks, admin.ts admin API calls, features.ts flags, pages.ts CMS, footer.ts), src/types.ts (shared TS types), src/components/* . Docs live at api-node root (OG-SETUP.md etc.). Task artifacts under api-node/.agents/tasks/seo-module/ (NOT part of the app).
